ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER Accused No.1 in Crime No.235/2024 registered by Sarjapura Police Station, Bengaluru District for the offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'IPC') and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (for short 'DP Act') is before this Court under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, seeking regular bail.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent - State.
3. FIR in Crime No.235/2024 was registered against the petitioner and two others based on the first information dated 20.06.2024 received from Sanaulla who is the father of deceased Riana.

sentences.text: During the course of investigation of the case, the petitioner herein was arrested on 21.06.2024 and subsequently remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation of NC: 2025:KHC:9549 the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against three persons.
Petitioner herein is arrayed accused No.1 in the charge sheet.
4. The bail application filed by the petitioner under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code before the jurisdictional Court in Crl.Misc.No.5439/2024 is dismissed on 23.10.2024.
It is under these circumstances, the petitioner is before this Court seeking regular bail.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner reiterated the grounds urged in the petition and prays for grant of regular bail.
6. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has seriously opposed the bail petition and prays for dismissal of the petition.

7. Perusal of the material on record would go to show that the marriage of the petitioner with deceased Riana was performed on 23.05.2024 and in the first information, it is alleged that at the Shabaz vs The State Of Karnataka on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66743299/
2 time of marriage, dowry was paid to the petitioner as per the demand made.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is also averred NC:
2025:KHC:9549
that after the marriage, Riana was ill-treated and tortured in her matrimonial house and demand was made to bring additional dowry.

However, in the first information, there is no mention of any specific incident, wherein the accused persons had ill-treated or tortured Riana in furtherance of their demand to bring additional dowry.
In the first information, it is mentioned that on 17.06.2024 deceased Riana and the petitioner herein had come to the house of the first informant to celebrate Bakrid Festival.
It is also mentioned that on the said day, Riana had not made any complaint to the first informant.
Thereafter, on 19.06.2024, at about 04:00 p.m., Riana had telephoned to her mother and had spoken to her and she had not made any complaint even on the said date.
Subsequently, at about 07:00 p.m. on the very same day, she had committed suicide by hanging herself in the matrimonial house.
8. The petitioner who has no other criminal antecedents is in custody from 20.06.2024.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that petitioner's NC: 2025:KHC:9549 prayer for grant of regular bail needs to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER
The Criminal Petition is allowed.
